title: Adding Slides and Reading Cards | LayerCue from Zero, Episode 5
description:
Fill a presentation with real media: what a slide is, Add File and drag and drop, the difference between adding between cards and replacing on a card (and undo), pasting text into slides, reading a card, reordering, copying and moving slides, deleting with undo, and card size.
New here? Start with Episode 1: Meet LayerCue — The Main Window.
Recorded on LayerCue 0.9.12.
Manual: https://layercue.com/docs/slides/
The narration is AI-generated and the music is built from GarageBand loops. The event, sponsors and media in the demo are fictional.
